title: Symmetry of lifted adjacency
statement: Let $G$ be a regular multigraph on a vertex set $V$, and give each vertex a Boolean label. If $(x,b)$ is joined to $(y,c)$ in the two-sheeted lift—meaning some neighbor slot at $x$ leads to $y$ and $c$ is the complement of $b$—then $(y,c)$ is joined to $(x,b)$ in the same sense.
hypotheses_covered: There is a lifted adjacency from $(x,b)$ to $(y,c)$, witnessed by a neighbor slot and opposite Boolean labels
